title.narrative: FAUTAPO 2023 Empowerment av kvinnor/män och accelerator av marknadssystem
FAUTAPO 2023 Empowerment of women/men and accelerator of market systems

description.narrative: Att utveckla produktionsprotokoll och affärsplaner för att artikulera hållbara och miljövänliga produktiva initiativ, till nya marknader.
To develop production protocols and business plans to articulate sustainable and environmentally friendly productive initiatives, to new markets.

The main objective of the proposal have not changed. They will continue to contribute to environmental protection, climate change adaptation and mitigation, and sustainable economic development in bolivia.
According to the reformulated proposal, the main expected results are: * Enhanced and inclusive conservation, restoration and sustainable management and use of forests and biodiversity, inside and outside protected areas, including forest fire prevention and the implementation of climate change adaptation and mitigation efforts. * Promote sustainable production models that allow the country to benefit from its natural resources in an ecologically sustainable manner. * Strengthen environmental governance and institutional structures and capacity for environmental protection, improve access to justice and human rights, and enhance the protection of the environment. * Increasing women's participation in decision-making and activities related to the environment, climate change and sustainable production.
At the end of the intervention, 205 family productive units will be benefited and the and the areas to be intervened will be 5 instead of 3 as in the initial proposal.
In addition a final phase has been added for achieving a sustainable closure of the program: * Responsibly and efficiently conclude the program, under the comprehensive model implemented for the empowerment of women and men, with family productive units with quality products, equitable and competitive access to markets, in environments with gender equity, promoting their autonomy and cooperation in the market system.

As to the first half of 2023, when it comes to i), FAUTAPO and its targeted productive units implemented at least seven quality protocols that improved the production of six products: grapes, honey, apples, peaches, coffee, and cocoa in ten different regions (municipalities) of the country. However, the completion of business plans for most of the above mentioned products is still on process.
When it comes to ii) some actions to reduce the carbon footprint in FAUTAPO's agricultural initiatives were taken, especially in the Amazon region where the intervention is centered in the preservation of biodiversity and forests. In this respect, several families were selected as they already implemented the methodology known as "successional agroforestry systems", especially for coffee and cocoa plantations.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
